U03T121Exploreconnorott/pluginsSummarize tft_targets.py reference23:0219s101.6k14.4kreferences/tft_targets.py——- **Purpose:** Builds the forward labels (forward log returns and forward realised volatility over several horizons, per ticker) that a sequence forecasting model is trained on.—
